items.q: right now I've been working with Dr. Vollmer, who's a dentist, and he's got a group called the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band

ctx.x: Yeah, uh-huh. And I got a lot of joy out of doing that. But the -- the thing you figure I'm interested in -- right now I've been working with Dr. Vollmer, who's a dentist, and he's got a group called the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band, and he takes them to Europe every year, and he drives the bus, and he books them and --
When did you last go on this?
